title: Harden how GitHub text is displayed: filter the HTML in issues, pull requests, comments and previews
summary: GitHub text (issues, pull requests, comments, discussions) and the Markdown previews now show only safe formatting: the shared Markdown renderer runs a cleaning step (rehype-sanitize) whether embedded HTML is switched on or off. 23 new tests; images, tables, collapsible sections, key caps, code blocks and task checkboxes still render.
